scenes.label: 01 · THE LIVE OUTCOME
scenes.caption: One real payment → proof-gated CC3 settlement → the same payload executed back on Sepolia.
scenes.narration: AttestFlow gives a cross-border freelancer automatic escrow without trusting a payment oracle. The live result is one real 0.01 Ether payment on Sepolia, one Attestcoin-verified release on Creditcoin, and the exact settlement payload executed back on Sepolia.

scenes.label: 02 · NATURAL LANGUAGE TO POLICY
scenes.caption: Natural language writes intent. Deterministic policy and proof gates control money.
scenes.narration: The user writes a plain-language rule: when I receive at least 0.01 Ether on Sepolia, release ten percent. The agent compiles that sentence into an inspectable policy, watches only blocks already attested by Creditcoin, builds the proof, settles escrow, and delivers the result. The model is never trusted to say a payment happened.

scenes.label: 03 · ATTESTCOIN-GATED SETTLEMENT
scenes.caption: The live CC3 transaction releases 0.001 CTC only after native BlockProver verification.
scenes.narration: This is the live Creditcoin settlement transaction. Inside it, the Attestcoin BlockProver verifies the transaction's Merkle inclusion and source-chain continuity. The contract then releases 0.001 CTC. An agent assertion alone cannot create this state change.

scenes.label: 04 · DEFENSE IN DEPTH
scenes.caption: Inclusion is not enough: the ASC binds index, receipt success, policy, escrow and replay state.
scenes.narration: Inclusion is necessary, but it is not enough. The contract derives the source transaction index from the Merkle path itself, rejects a caller-invented index, checks the attested receipt status equals one, matches the payee and amount against the stored policy, checks escrow, and rejects replay.

scenes.label: 05 · THE LOOP CLOSES
scenes.caption: The exact CC3-published payload executes on Sepolia behind a second replay guard.
scenes.narration: The settlement publishes a destination-bound message. These exact bytes are signed, delivered, and executed by the Sepolia Inbox. The published and executed payload hashes are identical, and the destination has its own replay guard.

scenes.label: 06 · HONEST BOUNDARY + RECOVERY
scenes.caption: A failed destination call resumes only the missing leg; the Writability adapter boundary is explicit.
scenes.narration: The official Writability contracts are not deployed on this testnet, so this return leg uses one authorized relayer and does not pretend to have attestor-quorum security. During the recorded run, CC3 finalized before a Sepolia RPC timeout. On restart, the agent recovered the original event and completed only the missing destination leg.

scenes.label: 07 · REPRODUCE THE VERDICT
scenes.caption: Five gates: CI · 62 live checks · 2 exact matches · shared batch · fresh single proof.
scenes.narration: One command gives judges a five-gate receipt: thirty-two tests and production checks; sixty-two public-chain assertions; two Sourcify exact matches; one shared multi-block batch proof; and one fresh single proof. Every result is independently rerunnable.

scenes.label: 08 · ATTESTFLOW
scenes.caption: Natural language for intent. Attestcoin for truth. Deterministic contracts for money.
scenes.narration: AttestFlow turns natural language into bounded intent, Attestcoin into cross-chain truth, and deterministic contracts into enforceable payment outcomes. The source, settlement, delivery, code, and verifier are all public. This is autonomous finance with a cryptographic stop button.
